title: The U.S. is building barriers around drones and robots, but China has scale to get around them
summary: The U.S. is implementing restrictions on foreign-made drones and robots to limit Chinese technology influence in critical sectors. However, China's manufacturing scale suggests these barriers may redirect competition to other markets rather than eliminate it. The policy reflects escalating U.S.-China tech competition and protectionist trends.
content: The U.S. is shutting out more foreign-made drones and robots. China’s scale means the global competition may simply move elsewhere.

zh.title: 美国正在为无人机和机器人设置障碍，但中国的规模让它有办法绕过
zh.summary: 美国正在对外国制造的无人机和机器人实施限制，以限制中国技术对关键部门的影响。然而，中国的制造规模表明这些障碍可能只会将竞争转向其他市场，而不是消除竞争。这项政策反映了美中科技竞争和保护主义趋势的升级。

title: Grindr wants to be the everything app for gay men; investors are still deciding whether it can pull it off
summary: Grindr CEO George Arison is expanding the dating app into a comprehensive platform with AI features, a premium tier, and healthcare services to counter Wall Street's historical undervaluation. The company aims to position itself as an all-encompassing social platform for gay men. Investor confidence in the expansion strategy remains uncertain.
content: George Arison is done letting Wall Street's "Grindr discount" go unchallenged — in a wide-ranging Q&A, the CEO walks us through how AI, a controversial $350-plus EDGE tier, and a bet on healthcare and long-distance matchmaking are turning Grindr into the "gayborhood in your pocket" he's been promising since 2022.

zh.title: Grindr想成为同志男性的全能应用；投资者仍在决定它是否能做到
zh.summary: Grindr首席执行官乔治·艾瑞松正在将这款约会应用扩展为一个全面平台，包括人工智能功能、高级订阅和医疗保健服务，以对抗华尔街长期以来对其的低估。该公司旨在将自己定位为同志男性的全方位社交平台。投资者对这一扩展战略的信心仍然不确定。
